title: The Stone
caption: The stone in the middle of the bay, in the moonlight.

boat.means: his boat moored by the stone's left (its lantern on the bow, his net in it); false — the bay empty but for the stone

lantern.means: the lantern on the boat's bow: 1 lit, 0 out (only while the boat is here)

net.means: his net: heaped in the boat by the thwart / hauled over the bow into the water (П.2–П.3; round her shoulders when she is in it)

fisherman_at.means: where the Fisherman is (lib.PLACES): standing in his boat by the bow / knee-deep on the sandbar at the stone's right front (1.1) / to the shoulders in the deep water before the stone (3С.1); set, put there at once

mermaid_at.means: where the Mermaid is (lib.PLACES): sitting on the edge of the stone's flat top, her tail hanging down its front / to the shoulders in the water at its left front / to the shoulders off the boat's bow, in his net (П.3); set, put there at once. Her not here (mermaid_here false) — the stone empty

deep_lights.means: two pale lights under the water before the stone (the ending «Два огня»)

far_light.means: a lantern far away on the right going to the town: 0 none; 0+ on the shore road, 0.5 at the bridge's end, 1 at the hill's top, going over (3С.1, «Два огня»)

fisherman_a.means: the scene's own: where the Fisherman stands across, set from fisherman_at

fisherman_d.means: the scene's own: where the Fisherman stands ahead, set from fisherman_at

fisherman_e.means: the scene's own: how high over the bay's floor the Fisherman stands (in the deep water), set from fisherman_at

fisherman_placed.means: the scene's own: the place the Fisherman was last put at

mermaid_a.means: the scene's own: where the Mermaid stands across, set from mermaid_at

mermaid_d.means: the scene's own: where the Mermaid stands ahead, set from mermaid_at

mermaid_e.means: the scene's own: how high over the bay's floor the Mermaid stands (in the deep water), set from mermaid_at

mermaid_placed.means: the scene's own: the place the Mermaid was last put at

light.means: the hour (hours.md): night — the full moon high (the default); evening — an evening going into night, rose and amber low over the far shore, the moon pale; dawn — the sky greying, pearl low, the moon faint. Sets dusk and dawn at once

dusk.means: the scene's own (hours.md): how much of the evening's light and sky — set from `light`; a piece moves it slowly (evening → night)

dawn.means: the scene's own (hours.md): how much of the dawn's light and sky — set from `light`; a piece moves it slowly (night → dawn)

haul.means: his net drawn in (М1, М7): 0 — cast, a length out on the water off the bow; 1 — drawn in under the stem (with her in it, П.3). Only with `net` over

heel.means: the boat heeling under the net's weight as he hauls: 0 level … 1 the bow dipped (the script turns it into boat_tilt)

boat_tilt.means: the scene's own: the boat's tilt in degrees, set from heel

fish.means: the catch in the net over the bow: 0 empty … 1 full of fish (П.5, М7; 0.5 — half a net)

knot.means: the knot of the net by her hand (М1б): 0 tight … 1 loose (she can slip out)

splash.means: a pulse: each new value (counted up) — her tail beats the water, a splash at her feet

pass_light.means: a pale light passing under the boat's keel (4.6): move it 0 → 1 → 0

net_hole.means: his net torn (the trace of М1, of М8б): 0 whole; 1 torn at the edge; 2 torn wider — seen on the net over the bow and in the heap

beat.means: the piece playing (notes.md «Pieces»; the world's beats)

beat_next.means: the piece the game will play next (its cut made ready)

looks.means: a piece's variant (go_word, go_free): false — she slips out not looking at him (М1б held long)

net_way.means: a piece's variant (evenings): how he let her go — for her word (she sings, the net full) / for nothing (the stone empty, then she by herself) — the contract's key «net», named so here: the scene's `net` is where the net is

objects.name: Far shore with the fir wood
A lantern going to the town
A pale light under the keel

prompts.text: slow harp arpeggios over the night sea, a fairy tale told evenly, moonlight on the water
a wordless female voice singing far out over the water, a sea-girl's song, tender and strange
solo cello, long low phrases, a young fisherman's longing, restrained and warm
glassy celesta and glass harmonica, the moon's path on a dark bay, fragile and luminous
slow sea swell under a soft string pad, waves against a wooden pier at night
deep underwater ambient, muffled and slow, light falling through green water, sand and weed swaying
low wordless male choir humming slow plainchant in a stone church, candlelight and stern grace
a small harmonium holding plain hymn chords in a white room on a hill, a door open on the night
dark frame drum and a low drone under a full moon in a fir wood, a witch's slow circle dance
a fiddle and a wooden pipe playing a folk dance far off on a town square, lanterns, festive and hollow
the crackle of a hearth in a low room under a sparse plucked lute, quiet and close
high thin violin harmonics like a soul without a heart, cold and searching
a slow tambourine shimmer and a sinuous reed melody, a dancer's bare feet, seductive and dangerous
sparse felt piano, single notes with long silences, a parable spoken evenly
soft ambient pads and a faint bell, the lights of a town over a dark river at night
low brass chorale, very slow, a sea that blesses no one, grave and bright sadness
wind through firs at midnight, creaking branches, sparse and cold
a slow lullaby on a music box sinking under water, half heard
